name: Filesystem Scope Enforcement
description: Extensions and tools receive scoped filesystem access. Path traversal, symlink following, and scope escape attempts are blocked. Filesystem operations are mediated through a capability-based filesystem handle.
purpose: Prevent extensions and tools from accessing files outside their designated scope by enforcing capability-based filesystem handles that block traversal, symlink escape, and scope violations.
acceptanceCriteria: Extensions receive scoped filesystem handles, not raw filesystem access
Path traversal attacks (../) are blocked at the handle boundary
Symlink following that would escape the scope is blocked
Scope escape attempts produce security event receipts
Filesystem handles enforce read/write/delete scope separately
Filesystem handles have configurable scope boundaries at creation time
